data.narrative:
Aurelius Systems is a seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $10M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies (2 public, 8 private) in the defense and security sector, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $25M. Peer-median analysis benchmarks against three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A)—producing a median valuation of $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $21M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $212M. The substantial dispersion reflects material uncertainty around which peer trajectory is most applicable: the stage-progression method anchors to current capital deployed, while the peer-median method incorporates market-clearing valuations in the sector but operates across a wide range of stage and size profiles. The composition and scale variance within the three-company peer median cohort is a primary source of valuation uncertainty.
